Build every skill, one answer at a time

Your checked answers guide the next question. Choose textbook-first practice or require a new AI question every time, using the selected textbook topic and reference material as context. A miss gets a simpler follow-up; two correct answers at the same level raise the challenge. Practice rotates through concepts, calculations, units & direction, graphs & data, and explaining & applying ideas across your selected topics.

Use a suitable unused textbook question first. If none matches the topic, skill and level, AI creates a new one using a textbook reference question, its diagrams and worked solution.

373 original numbered Review Questions from all 30 sections in six chapters. 373 prebuilt AI answers and worked solutions are embedded for immediate offline access. Show answer uses the embedded solution by default. The optional AI checkbox generates an additional answer and worked solution online while keeping the original prebuilt version visible. These solutions were authored in this session, are separate from the publisher key, and can contain mistakes; source ambiguities are labelled. All subparts, tables and diagrams stay with their question. Inline Practice Problems, Quick Checks and Activities are excluded. Questions, drawing and progress work offline. All source questions are unranked; adaptive levels are practice estimates.

Room to grow

First attempts guide your next topic and difficulty. Reviews don’t inflate your score.

Start at foundation level. Two correct answers at the same level move you up; a miss brings the next question down a level. Question level is estimated from its type: warm-ups and sample prompts, regular practice and investigations, then chapter review and extra practice.
